details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> server, ui: only offer a working directory when a tool reads it (#26762) The working directory chip showed up as soon as the server exposed any builtin tool, so a server started with just get_datetime, or a user who turned every filesystem tool off in the settings, still got a control that nothing would read. Tools now declare whether they resolve their paths and run against the working directory, next to the write permission they already publish in the /tools listing.
